description: Gather context about the proposed PR
details:
First resolve proposed_pr to the exact proposed PR specification. The use the proposal directory from input_state as feature_id in the first gather_context action: {"kind":"gather_context","feature_id":"<work-item-name>","types":["proposed_prs","requirements","approach","invariants","guidance","features","acceptance_criteria","expected_tests","required_test_cases","risks","decisions"],"keywords":["<proposed-pr-id>"]}. feature_id scopes proposal discovery to docs/proposals/<work-item-name> and keywords identify the proposed PR within that directory. Do not use a semantic feature ID, the proposed PR ID, or a keyword-only fuzzy lookup as feature_id. Use the gathered context to identify the proposed PR, its goals, scope, acceptance criteria, tests, dependencies, risks, and related requirements. Use read_document only when a specific section of a known document is needed. Do not guess a path when gathered context provides the path. Record the exact specification path and all relevant implementation context in output_state. If the lookup is ambiguous or returns no match, choose prompt_user with one precise question instead of guessing.

Instantiation context: work item name is 'interaction-file-logging'; workflow instance name is 'proposed-pr-1-implementation-specification'. Use these values as search context and verify repository documents before deciding what they identify.
